_about: Answer key for the quality check (scripts/quality-check.js). Never copied into the scratch project.
Paths are as they appear in the scratch project, after the runner's renames (dot-claude -> .claude, *.fixture -> *).
A finding catches a bug when its file is one of `files` (or it names no file, or a URL, and `fileless` is true) and its
sentences satisfy `match`: a list of alternatives, each a list of case-insensitive regexes that must ALL match.
Sentences are the finding's what, context, fix and key (raw JSONL), or its report entry line, plain sub-bullets and
Top Issues summary. They carry no code names (finding-contract.md), so `match` names the consequence in plain words.
Evidence (the receipt and the attachments: Expected, Actual, Screenshot, Evidence) is never matched: a receipt that
prints a block of code quotes whatever sits nearby, so even a precise pattern turns up in a neighbouring finding's
`lines` documents where each bug sits (the tests check it still does). Every bug here leaves `lineMatch` false, as
on the first fixture: a line window credits a different finding that happens to sit on the same lines.
`app` names the app and the two commits the runner makes from base/ and change/ (the author is "<name> Dev").
`selfTestPair` names the oracle self-test's required pair: a correct fix for one runnable bug, an empty fix for another.
A bug that no script can run carries `noOracle`, the reason; every other bug has a gone and a works oracle in oracles/.
This fixture is held out as the judge (scripts/quality-check.js header, "Notebook chooses, Pocket judges"): a run
on it may correct this key, with every saved run of it rescored, but nothing else is ever tuned on its results.

app.name: Pocket
app.changeMessage: Add the month view, edit, export, report, import, close-month and a contributor command

bugs.description: Saving an edit replaces the row with the validated fields alone, so the expense loses its id and can no longer be edited or deleted (its links point at /edit/undefined).
The new cell() helper puts its content into the page without esc(), and the list rows and the report pass the note and category through it, so a note holding markup runs in the page.
A failed add (a bad amount) redirects to /add?error=1, which shows "Invalid input" over empty fields; the base re-rendered the form with what was typed and a message naming the field.
match: vague|generic|which field|doesn't say|does not say|unhelpful|no detail|not specific|unclear|uninformative

bugs.description: The month dropdown's script sits inline in the page head, runs before the select exists, and is guarded with if (select), so choosing a month does nothing and no error shows.
The plan decides export columns date,category,amount,note with two-decimal amounts; /export.csv writes id,date,amount,category,note with the amounts as stored.
month-report.md says it previews the month's report without changing any data, then its step 3 runs the close-month script, which moves the month's expenses into archive/.
bugs.noOracle: a prompt file: whether its description and its step 3 still disagree is a reading of the text, and what an agent does with it is not deterministic, so no script can run it

bugs.description: The import command adds moment 2.29.1, below the fixes for CVE-2022-24785 (locale path traversal, fixed in 2.29.2) and CVE-2022-31129 (ReDoS, fixed in 2.29.4).

The README puts a new "Closing a month" section with the archive command right after the opening, and moves Getting started to the end, so a newcomer meets a data-moving command before learning how to run the app.
bugs.noOracle: README order: whether a newcomer learns how to run the app before meeting a command that moves data is a reader's judgment, not a behaviour a script can run
match: closing a month|close command|archive command|npm run close

bugs.description: Known-answer case (the 7.2.0 capped-list miss): the month view shows at most 20 rows and computes its count and total from the shown rows, so a month with more than 20 expenses reports a wrong count and total and says nothing was left out.
